provenance.scope: The review branch contains the curve-memory prototype and integration on published main. Other unpublished local civil/UI/geometry changes are excluded. Benchmarks used this branch build.

build.compiler: c++.exe (MinGW-W64 x86_64-ucrt-posix-seh, built by Brecht Sanders, r8) 13.2.0
build.windows_runtime: Static MinGW C++ runtime; Windows system DLLs remain dynamic

provenance.source_hash_format: SHA-256 of exact Git blobs at code_commit, independent of checkout CRLF conversion; includes every C++ source/header, CMakeLists.txt and process benchmark runner

publication_note: Only local workspace prefixes have been removed from strings. Measurements, floating-point values, checksums and child command arguments are otherwise unchanged. Input Benchy STL is local and not included. The separate v1-validation.json reports the earlier implementation.

local_workspace_curve_memory_ctest.scope: Curve-memory tests only; this is not a claim that all unrelated local workspace tests pass.

benchy.measurement_scope: Estimated capacity bytes for scene representation; excludes benchmark inputs, verification copies, allocator bookkeeping and process overhead. Cache is included.
benchy.baseline: Ordinary shared unique float64 point arrays with identical topology, instance matrices, sparse overrides and relations.
benchy.batch_timing_note: Identical queries and checksums. Grouping by instance and allocating output buffers happen once outside timing for both readers. Batch calls include index validation, internal block grouping, scatter to original query order, and checksum work.
benchy.timing_note: Fixed deterministic query lists; three repeats; total wall-clock milliseconds including checksum work. Cold clears cache before each repeat. Warm-start uses a prepass but may still miss when the working set exceeds cache capacity.

torus_128_placements.measurement_scope: Estimated capacity bytes for scene representation; excludes benchmark inputs, verification copies, allocator bookkeeping and process overhead. Cache is included.
torus_128_placements.baseline: Ordinary shared unique float64 point arrays with identical topology, instance matrices, sparse overrides and relations.
torus_128_placements.batch_timing_note: Identical queries and checksums. Grouping by instance and allocating output buffers happen once outside timing for both readers. Batch calls include index validation, internal block grouping, scatter to original query order, and checksum work.
torus_128_placements.timing_note: Fixed deterministic query lists; three repeats; total wall-clock milliseconds including checksum work. Cold clears cache before each repeat. Warm-start uses a prepass but may still miss when the working set exceeds cache capacity.

process_comparison.measurement_note: Each raw/auto run uses a new native process with identical shapes, topology, placements and deterministic queries. Policies alternate first-run order each repeat. Counter snapshots measure actual child process RAM; no source document remains at source_released. Allocator-retained memory remains counted. Peaks include construction. Small differences within min/max spread are not proven savings.
process_comparison.baseline_note: Raw policy uses shared shapes and the same scene metadata/matrix placement with contiguous binary64 point arrays. This compares codec/storage selection costs, not sharing against fully duplicated geometry. Dense generated curves are a synthetic fixture and do not predict imported CAD results.

raw.process_memory_note: Actual process counters. source_released is the retained scene before query buffers; allocator-retained free memory remains counted. after_batch_reads includes reusable query plans and outputs. Peak includes loading, conversion, source overlap, allocator high water and benchmark buffers; it is not steady scene RAM. No heap trimming or working-set eviction is forced.
raw.fixture_note: Torus is a native topological CAD mesh. Dense-curves is a synthetic dyadically sampled cubic fixture with no faces, not evidence of savings on imported CAD or Benchy. Additional placement copies share existing shapes and do not enlarge unique geometry.
raw.timing_note: One cold pass after cache clear and one immediate warm-start pass per workload. A working set larger than cache may still miss. Batch plan groups by instance in chunks <=512 and is prepared outside read timing; plan cost reported separately. Timed reads include outputs, scatter, checksum and internal decode/sort allocations. Parent runner repeats each configuration in separate processes.
